subject: imported-post-status
detail: B's posts have no status and are all live (B-F03); the unified Post requires a status and every new post starts pending (A-F04). If B's existing posts are imported, they need a status, and the choice decides whether they stay visible.
solutions: Import B's posts as published, marked imported_from = B, so they stay visible; moderators may reject any later
Import B's posts as pending so moderators re-review everything (they disappear from public view until reviewed)
recommended: Import as published with imported_from = B; they were already public, and moderators can reject any of them

subject: imported-anonymous-posts
detail: B allows posts with no author (author_id null, B-F04); the unified Post requires an author for new posts (A-F02) and anonymous posting is deferred (M07). Imported anonymous B posts would be rejected by a NOT NULL author.
solutions: Allow a null author only on imported B rows (check: author_id is not null or imported_from = 'B')
Assign imported anonymous posts to one placeholder account
Skip anonymous B posts on import (data loss)
recommended: Allow a null author only on imported B rows, enforced by a check constraint; new posts always need an author

subject: b-hardcoded-signing-key
detail: B signs and verifies JWTs with a literal key in api.py (scan: 2 medium findings) and passes no algorithms list to decode. B's sign-in (M02) is dropped, but nothing from B's auth code may be carried over.
solutions: Carry over nothing from B's token code; one cookie-session system configured from environment variables
If a token API is ever needed, a new key from the environment with a fixed algorithm and expiry
recommended: Carry over nothing from B's token code; existing B tokens stop working after the merge and B users sign in again
